title: gcp-resource-inventory.json — Discover phase IaC inventory
description: Complete inventory of discovered GCP resources with classification, dependencies, and AI detection. Produced by the discover-iac fragment. FLOOR contract (required structure only; additional properties allowed). Classification RULES (how a resource becomes PRIMARY/SECONDARY, tier assignment, depth calculation) are the discover-iac prose + references/clustering/, not this schema.

project_directory.description: Absolute path to the analyzed Terraform.

resources.description: All discovered resources with classification, tier, dependency depth, and cluster assignment.

address.description: Terraform resource address (e.g. google_cloud_run_service.orders_api). NOT id/resource_address.

type.description: Terraform resource type (e.g. google_cloud_run_service). NOT resource_type.

classification.description: PRIMARY (maps independently) or SECONDARY (supports a primary). NOT class/category.

secondary_role.description: SECONDARY resources only: the support role played.

serves.description: SECONDARY resources only: primary resource addresses this resource serves.

depth.description: Dependency depth (0 = foundational, N depends on depth N-1).

cluster_id.description: Which cluster this resource belongs to.

ai_detection.description: AI-workload detection results derived from the IaC.

has_ai_workload.description: Whether any AI/ML workload signal was found in the Terraform.

signals_found.description: Detection signals: method, pattern, confidence, evidence.
